subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw expose blocked Telegram/WhatsApp DM content to trusted pre-auth hooks and make grouped DM allowlist config/API part of the channel/plugin contract?
rationale: The implementation changes a pre-admission security boundary and adds public/plugin configuration contracts that automation can review mechanically but cannot accept as product/security policy.

options.title: Approve bounded pre-auth contract
options.body: Accept the new trusted pre-auth hook and grouped allowlist API after owner review confirms exposure, redaction expectations, and upgrade behavior are intentional.

options.title: Narrow to internal access requests
options.body: Keep the operator notification workflow but remove or privatize plugin-facing pre-auth and grouped config surface until the API is formally designed.

options.title: Defer to shared audit design
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of a channel-agnostic denied-inbound audit/event primitive covering Telegram, WhatsApp, retention, rate limiting, and notification policy.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded pre-auth contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new trusted pre-auth hook and grouped allowlist API after owner review confirms exposure, redaction expectations, and upgrade behavior are intentional.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest sampled ownership signal across the affected hook, config, command, and plugin-boundary surfaces.
